goal: Usable native full-duplex voice with natural English/British speech, reliable silence/interruptions and asynchronous delegated reasoning.
current_stage: Prototype with functioning native training/restore; end-to-end quality still fails. Not production qualification.
count_verification: Ran the real LoRA installer on36 metadata-only layers shaped from actual saved checkpoint; no native base weights allocated, no model inference or optimizer updates.
implementation_hazard: Existing35-layer frozen prefix cannot train adapters in layers32..34. It bypasses their computation/gradients. New explicit fast-path guard rejects trainable or adapted layers before prefix boundary, including frozen-but-enabled adapters.
experiment_design: First compare1vs4layers; do not launch8layer/full-weight/new-base expansion simultaneously.

Use the same chosen preserved parent, exact complete corpus/folds/word/audio targets, minibatch order, effective batch size, losses, update budget and native evaluation. Preserve all parent history/Adam/RNG/OPAL; no optimizer reset hidden inside a capacity comparison.

Initialize new lower-layer LoRA B to zero so the initial function can match the reference. Prove native logits/hidden equivalence before updates. Preserve inherited optimizer counters/moments for existing parameters; initialize new parameter states explicitly.

Do not reuse35-layer hidden inputs as trainable four-layer inputs. Reuse immutable original native embeddings/segments/targets; use full native differentiated forward or a newly versioned32-layer frozen boundary with exact numerical/gradient equivalence. No need to regenerate approved speech or teacher histories simply to add layers.

Use full64DEV and full native speech/control evaluation; loss reduction alone is insufficient. A larger adapter has succeeded only if actual behavior improves while speech/ordinary retention remain acceptable.
Native throughput/memory and spending/time need explicit admission before a paid comparison; this artifact authorizes zero new GPU intervals or optimizer updates.

parallel_priorities.next: Resolve premature or incomplete acoustic rendering with pinned native code and actual stop/conditioning evidence. Do not rerun rejected128token experiment unchanged.
Qualify implemented original-audio context route with general backend, selective cancellation and stale-result suppression; current old lookup benchmark is not this stack.
Controlled1vs4layer comparison after compatible gradient path and same-parent initialization proof.
Only promote a candidate after complete behavioral/speech tests, naturalness/British listening checks, latency/interruption tests and a working live conversation.

escalation: If the native base fails the speech/control requirements after verified runtime, compare a stronger duplex foundation. Full fine-tuning or structural growth is conditional on measured benefit and compute/data requirements, not an assumed path to commercial-system quality.
